items.title: Weathering the Billionaire Backlash
items.excerpt: ﻿﻿﻿Billionaires typically split their time and their capital between homes in many places, whereas for most citizens their democratic systems are their only homes. Those fragile homes are in need of rebuilding. By all means, bring your economic innovation and skills at capital allocation with you. But leave the hubris on the yacht.
